android_mechanism: Check whether a download is really required before performing it (static assets re-fetched every time)
bug_description: The weather condition glyphs (sunny/cloudy/overcast/rain) are rendered from four hard-coded remote CDN URLs (i-blog.csdnimg.cn). The forecast view shows ~9 icon instances per city tab (big current-weather icon plus per-day day/night icons); every cold start and every cache miss re-downloads these static images over the network, delaying first paint of the weather panel and wasting bandwidth.
fix_summary: The four weather glyphs are bundled as local rawfile resources and referenced with $rawfile, eliminating the network fetches and speeding up first render.
trigger_steps: Clear the app's network image cache (or reinstall); ensure network is available for weather data.
Start hitrace capture (categories: app, sched, network, net, ace).
Cold-start the app and wait for the weather panel to fully render; switch between 2 city tabs.
Stop hitrace. Repeat 3 repetitions (reinstall between repetitions) for unfixed, then install the fixed HAP and repeat 3 repetitions.

test_oracle.definition: (a) Time from page build start to weather-icon render completion in the ace trace; (b) bytes of image downloads to the icon CDN observed in the network trace.
test_oracle.comparison: unfixed downloads ~9 images (hundreds of KB) before/while icons appear and shows network stalls on cold start; fixed has zero icon-related network traffic and near-instant icon paint.

trace_config.command: hdc shell hitrace --time 25 ace app sched network net -o /data/local/tmp/wa_icons.chtrace
